title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-07-06
content:
Week: 2026-07-06 weekly sync (notes + standups)
Owner: Asha Patel
Status: in_review

Summary:
- Focus this week on two live on-prem installs (PharmaInc and TelcoOne), finishing KMS/HSM integration for BankCo POC, and stabilizing the VPC networking template (Terraform) to reduce customer firewall troubleshooting time.
- Main recurring blockers: corporate firewall rules, certificate chain issues for air-gapped installs, and OIDC group mapping inconsistencies when using Azure AD.

Key updates (high level):
- PharmaInc install: Onsite engineers completed GPU rack prep and network pre-checks on 2026-07-05. Install window scheduled 2026-07-08. Remaining: finalize signed certs (waiting on customer CA export) and finalize storage encryption policy in agreement with their security team.
- TelcoOne: Initial bootstrap succeeded but we hit an RBAC/CSI driver mismatch causing pods to restart. Patch queued (GH PR #247) — rollout to staging this afternoon.
- BankCo KMS/HSM: Integration tests passed for envelope encryption flows, but key rotation API surfaced a latency spike under concurrent requests (JIRA PD-3124). Engineering to add exponential backoff + metrics.
- VPC Terraform template: Added new optional egress CIDR whitelist and explicit NAT gateway docs. Helped reduce troubleshooting time in last three installs. Need to harden validation and preflight checks.

Standup logs / daily note fragments:
- 2026-07-06 (Mon)
  - Asha: Prioritize PharmaInc certs, coordinating with Solutions to get CA bundle by tomorrow morning. Booked install engineers for 2026-07-08 08:00 local.
  - Marco: Working on TelcoOne CSI patch; repro on staging completed. PR raised; aiming for rollback-safe deploy.
  - Priya: Ran KMS perf harness; reproduced rotation latency at 1200 RPS. Instrumenting with additional timers and traces.
  - Jonah: Updated VPC preflight script to include NAT/route table checks; testing with sample customer VPC.
  - Chen: Drafted runbook section for air-gapped cert import and rotation; needs review.

- 2026-07-07 (Tue)
  - Asha: Received CA export from PharmaInc (partial). Need chain from their security team. Opened support thread to escalate.
  - Marco: TelcoOne patch merged to staging, scheduled canary on prod cluster tomorrow. Noted one regression with metrics exporter — temporary disable pending fix.
  - Priya: Added retry/backoff for KMS rotate path; re-ran load test, latency back to baseline for 95th pct. Raised PD-3124 to done-pending-verification.
  - Jonah: Found a customer VPC using overlapping private CIDR that conflicts with our default routes; documented workaround and added explicit error message in preflight.
  - Chen: Finalized air-gapped cert runbook draft; asked Security to validate compliance wording.

Customer blockers (open):
- PharmaInc (customer-3461): Waiting on full CA chain and signed intermediate. Blocker since 2026-07-06. Impact: install cannot proceed past bootstrap. Owner: Asha. Jira: PD-3180.
- BankCo (customer-3428): KMS rotation latency under heavy load (seen during POC test). Impact: potential delays during key rotation windows. Owner: Priya. Jira: PD-3124.
- TelcoOne (customer-3499): CSI driver mismatch causing pod restarts. Current mitigation: rollback to previous driver while patch validated. Owner: Marco. Jira: PD-3117.
- RetailCo (customer-3412): SSO group-mapping failures for Azure AD leading to missing role assignments. Root-cause: token claim mapping differs between their AAD tenant versions. Pending: add tenant-specific mapping option. Owner: Chen. Jira: PD-3136.

Action items / next steps:
- Asha: Follow up with PharmaInc security lead (Karen L.) to get CA chain by 2026-07-07 EOD; escalate via Solutions SL.
- Marco: Roll out TelcoOne canary tonight 2026-07-07; monitor metrics and be ready to rollback. Post-mortem doc if regression persists.
- Priya: Finish additional KMS instrumentation and run a 2-hour soak test at 1500 RPS on 2026-07-08. Deliver verification notes to PD-3124.
- Jonah: Add overlapping-CIDR detection to preflight + create improved error message. Target PR by 2026-07-09.
- Chen: Incorporate Security feedback into the air-gapped cert runbook and publish to Confluence.
- Ops: Add Azure AD tenant mapping examples to onboarding checklist (owner: Solutions eng).

Meetings this week:
- Daily standup 09:30 PT — private-deployments channel (notes above).
- Install readiness check (PharmaInc) 2026-07-07 14:00 PT — attendees: Asha, Jonah, onsite lead (Samir), Solutions SE.
- Post-install review (tentative) 2026-07-09 10:00 PT — to capture lessons from PharmaInc and TelcoOne installs.

Risks & mitigation:
- Air-gapped cert delays: High risk for Pharma and regulated customers. Mitigation: pre-flight checklist, provide templated CA bundle instructions, escalate to customer security.
- KMS rotation spikes under concurrent requests: Medium risk for customers with aggressive rotation policies. Mitigation: backoff + circuit-breaker + runbook recommending staggered rotations.
- VPC CIDR overlaps causing networking blackholes: Medium risk. Mitigation: static checks in preflight, clear error messages, configuration guide.

Notes to self / rough TODOs (informal):
- Draft email template for customers for CA bundle export (include step-by-step, expected files) — send to Solutions.
- Add telemetry event for "preflight-failure:cidr-overlap" so we can aggregate by customer.
- Update on-prem installer to print exact failing iptables/route checks for easier ops debugging.

Relevant links / tickets:
- PD-3124: KMS rotation perf (in progress)
- PD-3180: PharmaInc cert chain (blocked)
- PD-3117: TelcoOne CSI regression (in progress)
- PD-3136: Azure AD group mapping (triage)
- GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-private-deployments/pull/247
- Confluence runbook draft: Private-Deployments-Runbook-2026 (internal)

Appendix: quick install checklist (short)
- Preflight: verify CIDR, NAT gateway, route tables, DNS resolver, proxy settings.
- Certificates: CA chain + cert + key in PKCS#12 or PEM, expiration > 90 days.
- Storage: mount tests, CSI driver version match.
- KMS: reachable endpoint + rotation credentials, test vector for envelope encryption.
- SSO: OIDC discovery URL, group claim name, test user mapping.

Prepared by: Asha Patel (eng-private-deployments)
Reviewers: Marco Li, Priya Singh, Chen Wu

-- end of weekly notes (working doc)
